name: Sabraan

attributes.attribute: a British goddess known from a single Romano-Celtic temple in Gloucestershire
possibly connected to a pre-Celtic goddess of the region

sources: Monaghan, Patricia. The Encyclopedia of Celtic Mythology and Folklore. Checkmark Books, 2008.
text: Sabraan is a British goddess. Our record of her comes from a single Romano-Celtic temple. The temple stands on a site in Gloucestershire. People may have lived on that land before the Celts came. Older worship may have left its mark there. The temple may honor a goddess who belonged to an earlier people. We have no other trace of Sabraan. Her name appears nowhere else in the surviving record. Her cult was small and local. She left no wider mark on Celtic myth.
